inference_engine: Work Luna semantic inference; no external provider/API
constraints: Human truth joined only after inference outputs were frozen and remote hash verified. No Round 1 overlap in primary. No post-as_of evidence used.
policy: Flag for human review if low_evidence_confidence, contradictory evidence, attachment parse failure with insufficient body, high-impact must_show at low confidence, or conflicting source-time observations.
interpretation: 100% is a corpus limitation result: all historical evidence packages were title/metadata only. It does not estimate a mature body+attachment pipeline's operational intervention rate.
